overall_worst.defect: Home 'What it does today' mixes two bordered cards with buttons ('Keeps selling offline', 'Every sale lands once') and eight unboxed text items, so the first two look orphaned and the section has no consistent component.
overall_worst.fix: Give all ten features one treatment in a single even two-column grid: drop the borders and buttons from the first two and turn the test links into inline text links inside those items (or box all ten identically).
